cohort: The study included 450 healthy pregnant women with gestational age between 38-42 weeks admitted to AL-Zahra teaching hospital in Tabriz, Iran.
finding: Participants with non-reactive NST results experienced more fetal complications, including significantly higher rates of bradycardia, descent arrest, low Apgar score, and cesarean section, compared to those with reactive NST results.
mod_finding: There was a significant difference in the type of delivery, specifically a higher rate of cesarean section, in the group with non-reactive NST results.
cross-section timing: Observations were made during the latent phase of labor and delivery.
